Santa Carla Boardwalk EatsThe Lost BoysSanta Carla nights. Garlic optional.Every recipe serves 4.
    StartersMainsSweetsDrinks
    StartersSanta Carla boardwalk friesThin fries tossed with garlic powder, parsley and salt, served in paper conesHow to make it1kg russet potatoes2 L vegetable oil1 tsp fine salt1 tsp garlic powder1/4 cup parsley, choppedCut the potatoes into thin fries. Soak in cold water, then drain and dry very well.Fry in batches in oil at 140°C for about 5 minutes until pale and soft, then rest on a rack.Reheat the oil to 190°C and fry again until golden and crisp.Toss with salt, garlic powder and parsley and serve in paper cones.Garlic breadBaguette with garlic parsley butter, baked in foil until crispHow to make it100g butter, soft4 garlic cloves, crushed1/4 cup parsley, chopped1/2 tsp salt1 baguetteMash the butter with the garlic, parsley and salt.Split the baguette and spread generously, then wrap in foil.Bake at 200°C, then open the foil and bake again to crisp the top.Frog brothers' roast garlic bean dipThe vampire hunters stock up on garlicHow to make itAs written, serves 4Silky cannellini dip loaded with a whole head of roasted garlic, lemon and olive oil, topped with chilli oil and parsley, with toasted pita chips.Wrap 1 whole garlic bulb in foil and roast at 200°C for 40 minutes.Cut 3 pita breads into wedges, brush with olive oil and bake for 8 minutes until crisp.Squeeze the soft garlic into a food processor with 2 drained 400g tins cannellini beans, the juice of 1 lemon, 60ml olive oil and salt, then blitz until smooth with a splash of water.Spread in a bowl and top with 1 tbsp chilli oil and chopped parsley.Boardwalk corn dogs with mustardMurder capital of the world, says the sign.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.MainsChinese takeaway noodlesWok chicken and egg noodles in oyster sauce, with egg fried rice on the sideHow to make it500g chicken thighs, sliced1/4 cabbage, shredded200g bean sprouts400g fresh egg noodles3 tbsp oyster sauce2 tbsp soy sauce1 tbsp sesame oil300g cooked jasmine rice2 eggs4 spring onions, sliced2 tbsp vegetable oilCook 120g jasmine rice ahead (the day before is best), spread it out and chill. Cold rice fries and holds better.Slice the chicken, shred the cabbage and slice the spring onions.Stir-fry the chicken in a smoking wok until browned.Add the cabbage, bean sprouts and noodles and toss with the oyster sauce, soy and sesame oil.Scramble the eggs in a second pan, add the rice and spring onion and fry until hot, then serve alongside.Grandpa's glazed meatloaf and mashDinner at Grandpa's place in Santa CarlaHow to make itAs written, serves 4Beef and pork meatloaf with a sticky brown sugar tomato glaze, sliced thick over buttery mashed potato with minted peas and gravy.Mix 500g beef mince, 250g pork mince, 1 grated onion, 1 egg, 60g breadcrumbs soaked in 80ml milk, 1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce and salt.Press into a loaf tin.Mix 100ml tomato sauce with 2 tbsp brown sugar and spread over the top.Bake at 180°C for 60 minutes and rest 10 minutes.Boil 1kg potatoes and mash with 60g butter and 100ml hot milk.Cook 400g frozen peas with mint and butter.Slice the meatloaf over the mash with peas and gravy.SweetsBoardwalk caramel popcornPopcorn coated in brown sugar and golden syrup caramel, baked crispHow to make it120g popcorn kernels150g brown sugar80g butter3 tbsp golden syrup1/2 tsp bicarb sodaPop the kernels in a covered pot and tip into a large bowl.Boil the sugar, butter and golden syrup for 4 minutes, then stir in the bicarb.Pour over the popcorn, toss and bake at 120°C, stirring every 15 minutes.Cool on the tray and break up.DrinksHoly water cucumber and lime fizzCucumber, lime and mint topped with soda water in small bottles, no alcoholHow to make it1 Lebanese cucumber3 limes, juiced1 cup mint leaves60ml sugar syrup600ml soda water1 cup iceChop half the cucumber and muddle with the lime juice, mint and syrup in a jug.Strain into small glass bottles or tall glasses filled with ice.Top with chilled soda water and a thin cucumber ribbon. Tie paper cross tags round the necks.Blood orange sodaDavid's bottle, passed round the cave.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.
